risks.title: Geographic concentration in the Permian Basin
risks.score_rationale: The risk is positioned at the top of the Business and Operational Risks section and describes a major vulnerability to a single region. The language emphasizes disproportionate exposure and significant adverse impact. The Industrial category is heavily weighted here due to concentrated critical assets. The risk is stable compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Dependence on upstream producer activity
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights that the company is entirely dependent on decisions made by producers, which it does not control. Natural production decline and reduced drilling activity are described as direct threats to revenue. The language is alarming (materially reduce our revenues). Risk is stable but central to the business model.

risks.title: Risks related to acquisitions and integrations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly tied to the growth strategy. The text mentions integration difficulties, loss of key customers, and cost overruns. The language is cautious (cannot provide any assurance). The Capital category is moderately weighted. Position similar to the prior year.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party pipelines
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned twice in the text, with strong language (temporary or permanent interruption, adverse effect). The company has no control over third-party operators. The Industrial category is relevant due to critical infrastructure. Position stable.

risks.title: Increased competition in midstream services
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as potentially making it harder to attract customers. Mentions of larger competitors and customers developing their own infrastructure. Language is concerned but less urgent than others. Competition category moderately weighted. Risk stable.

risks.title: Risks related to joint ventures
risks.score_rationale: The text specifies that the company does not control joint ventures, limiting its influence. Risks include uncontrolled costs and uncertain cash flows. Language is clear on material and negative impact. Industrial category relevant. Position unchanged.

risks.title: Indirect exposure to commodity prices
risks.score_rationale: The company states limited exposure but acknowledges that lower prices affect producers and thus their investment decisions. The link is indirect but documented. Language is measured (could reduce). Credit category applies due to customer solvency. Risk stable.

ai_positioning.summary: KNTK does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
